notes: Two branches (ح) meet at أبو معاوية; the names written once after him (الأعمش, شقيق, عبد الله) are the shared tail
«واللفظ له» is a Muslim gloss on which version is followed: left out
«وقال رسول الله» opens a second saying with no isnad of its own, so it is not a separate group; the shared tail ends at Abdullah
